candidate_event.threshold_scope: per asset using only feature history before each period
candidate_event.overlap_control: At most one candidate per asset until the previous 24h target matures.

extra_trees_head.sample_weight: inverse number of training events sharing the same timestamp

joint_veto.decision: Emit an up forecast only when both the expanding ExtraTrees head and the expanding positive-vs-negative WaveField memory assign at least 0.55 up probability.

diagnostic_ablations.status: post-holdout diagnostic; not used by the strict gate
